newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius sells $52.4 million of Treasury Bills.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius sells $52.4 million of Treasury Bills.

text.p: The Bank of Mauritius sold all the 1.05 billion rupees (52.4 million dollars) of Treasury Bills that it put on tender on Thursday, the central bank said.

The central bank said for this week's auction it sold 282.4 million rupees of 91 day, 290.9 million rupees of 182 day and 476.7 million rupees of 364 day bills with average weighted yields of 10.54 percent, 10.73 percent and 10.83 percent respectively.
This week's effective bank rate was posted at 10.72 percent per annum from 10.76 percent last week, the bank said.
Last week, the Bank of Mauritius sold 1.5 billion rupees of 91, 182 and 364 day Treasury Bills with weighted yields of 10.58 percent, 10.76 percent and 10.86 percent respectively.
